text: In the bull, the observable organs are two testicles protected by supple, thick skin called the scrotum, and the sheath of the penis; during mating, the glans penis and penis become visible. Internally, the testicles connect to the epididymis, which stores semen; the urethra is a duct inside the penis that ejects both sperm and urine. The prostate and seminal vesicles are glands that protect the spermatozoa.
